description: New browser regression assets/tests/pending-renewal.spec.ts reproduces: JWT expires after 3 seconds, parent obtains fresh token and init succeeds, host publishes answer 5 seconds after submission, answer never appears. Expiry unsubscribes original topic and clears pending_reply; Protocol.authenticate generates a fresh topic and Chat.open replaces request state on renewal. Host job still holds the original delivery context. A temporary no-renewal control with identical delayed mock passes. Keep sender/runtime authorization and response correlation intact when fixing. Test is intentionally unskipped and expects answer visibility.
title: Preserve in-flight reply delivery across JWT renewal
